notes.title: Viking Frontiers in its full version is now LIVE 📣
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The moment we’ve all been waiting for is here — [b]Viking Frontiers is now officially out on Steam[/b] in its full version! As of April 23, 2025, you can dive into the ruthless world of Norse warriors and lead your clan to honor, prosperity and glory! It's high time to find out how you will do as a mighty Jarl...

There is no time to waste - grab your axes, hammers, spears, bows and chisels and set out to conquer unexplored mountainous lands. But before that...


[h2]Marvel at the new Viking Frontiers Launch Trailer 🤩[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=o8CzpzRNzlw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Special thanks to all the Vikings out there 💪[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
On this joyful day, we cannot forget about you and your wonderful deeds, dear players. [b]We can’t thank you enough[/b] for the incredible support you've shown throughout the development of Viking Frontiers. Your participation in the Playtest, Demo, and Prologue versions has given us invaluable insights and feedback that helped us to shape and refine the game.

From start to finish, your unwavering support and positive energy have been essential to bringing this game to life. This release day is as much yours as it is ours — thank you for everything!


[h3]We don't want to keep you any longer. Go now, and conquer the world! ✊[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Our entire team wishes you [b]many amazing adventures, rewarding challenges, great achievements and victory over enemy clans,[/b] as you dive deeper and deeper into the story of Viking Frontiers. Remember that the life and work of Jarl is not an easy feat, but we believe that you will manage to achieve greatness and lead your clan to wealth and glory! 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/


[h3]Thank you, [b]Warriors[/b]! [/h3]

notes.title: Get ready! Viking Frontiers is coming on April 24
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Before we get to the point, we want to start by thanking you for your [b]warm welcome to Viking Frontiers: Prologue[/b]. Thanks to your feedback, suggestions, and great support, we made sure that the recent changes were made in the right direction. And while our work on the title is still in full swing, we are ready to announce that...


[h2]Viking Frontiers will hit Steam on April 24, 2025 🥳[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/477b529f29ad82243141a41235a653e4cd5704bc.jpg[/img]

Many of you have been eagerly asking us about the Viking Frontiers release date, so we are even more excited to assure you that you won't have to wait long! [b]In just one month[/b], you’ll have the opportunity to lead your own Viking clan and explore the full game content we've created for you. It will be the ultimate test of your leadership, building, crafting, hunting and exploration skills, and the stakes are really high... 

Rest assured, that our team is [b]doing everything in its power to deliver the best experience[/b] for you, working hard to smooth out the final imperfections. We know that Viking Frontiers is not without its issues yet, but we remain optimistic about the future and are committed to making sure everything runs smoothly and as planned.


[h2]Enjoy the new Date Reveal Teaser 👇[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
To make this special date even more unforgettable, we have prepared a short Date Reveal Teaser. What you can see in the video is, of course, [b]only a foretaste of what awaits you in the full version[/b] of the game, which will arrive on April 24. That being said, get ready for lots of surprises, new features and interesting locations just waiting to be discovered!

[previewyoutube=L31sbvndmPY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

• General changes to improve overall game stability

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The gods blessed us with their grace and sent us the [b]inspiration to craft yet another Hotfix.[/b] You, dear Vikings, were also generous with your amazing feedback, thanks to which we were able to prepare [b]a number of changes and fixes[/b] ⚒️ Know, that we are very happy to see your commitment and warm welcome to the Prologue version and will do our best to further improve our title.

[h2]Viking Frontiers: Prologue - Hotfix #3 notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Improvements to the general interactions (blocking, detection of interactive objects, fast interaction executions)
• Disabling the character's stench symbol (fish bones) - this feature will be available in the full version of the game
• Dialogue options selected by the player do not appear a second time in a conversation with an NPC
• Fixes to the hammer animation while building
• Interaction UI does not disappear between hammer blows
• The "R" key now collects all available items from the stash

[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.title: Viking Frontiers: Prologue has just launched
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
With the recent Steam Playtest now concluded, it's time to move forward with[b] the next crucial step [/b]in the development of the Viking Frontiers project. 

Know, that your feedback allowed us to draw a lot of conclusions about the gameplay elements that in your opinion require our attention, and allowed us to better understand your point of view and expectations. [b]We appreciate your input, Jarls![/b] 🤓


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/c7f45d9fa533367a1ce495531b4e03d3ede01956.png[/img]


[h2]Your Saga begins - Viking Frontiers: Prologue is now live [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
In a moment you will find yourself in unexplored, hostile Nordic lands, where you will face hardships of nature and dangerous wilderness. Will you be able to ensure the [b]survival of your people?[/b] Can you transform a small foothold into a [b]thriving settlement?[/b] Will the gods look upon you with [b]favor?[/b]

[b]Only you - the Jarl - can answer these questions 👑[/b]


[h2]Check out the latest Prologue Teaser 👀[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=PKZZenQ4vO0;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, there are many difficult challenges waiting for you... but also [b]opportunities to earn fame and glory.[/b] Viking Frontiers: Prologue will allow you to familiarize yourself with the basic gameplay mechanics and improve your ruling skills before the release of the full game. Speaking of which...

If you like what you see in the Prologue version, be sure to visit the main product page and add the title to your Steam Wishlist here 👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/]Viking Frontiers[/url]. With your support, we can reach an even wider range of players around the globe and spread the word about our project in much wider circles.

As always, we remain at your disposal on [b]Steam Discussions, our Discord server and Social Media[/b] channels. Please know that your opinions, suggestions and support are crucial to our entire team, so we are always happy to hear your thoughts. 




[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.title: Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playtest Hotfix 1.1.0p
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
A heartfelt thank you to all those who chose to try out the Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playest version! Thanks to your reports, suggestions and valuable feedback, our team was able to prepare [b]the first Hotfix,[/b] which addresses several important issues that you Vikings told us about.

Please know that each of your reports and ideas is carefully analyzed by our team, so we will be grateful for every piece of information you decide to share with us. The fastest and most convenient way to provide us with your opinion is to use this 👉 [url=https://forms.gle/DzAnif887ZMLLtcPA][b]dedicated Feedback Form.[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/2c12e73b7ba4839203126f3592d0e1d8e84f4cb4.png[/img]

[h2]Hotfix 1.1.0p Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Fixed an issue with saving game progress
• Fixed a bug that caused cut trees to disappear underground
• Fixed rain behavior (raining inside the shipwreck)
• Added an option to bind mouse keys
• The settlers' needs and diseases system has been disabled
• Improved the effect of structure decals on logs

[b]Note:[/b] After updating the game, your saves may stop working. We apologize for the inconvenience!


[h2]Please note 🤔[/h2]
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playtest is now LIVE 📣
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
And so, the saga unfolds once again. On this day, the Gods took their chosen ones and sent them into the uncharted, hostile wilderness that [b]they would now call home.[/b] Will they rebuild the power of their clan? Will they overcome the hardships of nature? And most importantly - will they survive? [b]It all depends on you[/b] - their honorable Jarl.


[h2]The Prologue Playtest has just started, and you can become our tester 🤩[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/76e4e79b5d9e4b11007f2465b80ed4e585d54d85.png[/img]

We are incredibly excited to announce that from now on, you can all enter our latest Steam Viking Frontiers Playtest. To do so, visit the [b]Viking Frontiers: Prologue Steam page[/b] and find the Playtest section (just above the announcements). Next, look for the green [b]Request Access button[/b] ✅, click it and... it's done! 

After requesting access, you should soon receive a message that you have been approved to Playtest. We will try to provide access to as many of you as possible. At the same time, we would like to point out that testers are selected randomly by the Steam panel.

We hope you are ready to take control of your clan's future and return to the majestic Nordic lands. This time, you will dive into the [b]new, enhanced and more refined version of Viking Frontiers[/b] for an even deeper and more thrilling experience. Explore, gather, build, craft, manage, and fight in the name of the Gods to prove yourself as one of [b]history’s greatest Viking leaders 👑[/b] Sounds amazing, right?


[h2]Your feedback is priceless 📜[/h2]

Please know that your feedback is very important to our entire team and that we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions. notes.title: Sign up for the Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playtest ☝️
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Through our conversations with you, dear Jarls, we know exactly how much you’re [b]looking forward to leading your own Viking clan[/b] once again. Your questions about when you'll have the chance to set sail for unknown lands and start a new settlement regularly appeared on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions panel. We decided that we could not leave them unanswered, so...


[h2]We have just opened [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue]Prologue Playtest Sign-ups[/url] 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
And you all can apply for access right now! To do this, visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838100/Viking_Frontiers_Prologue][b]Viking Frontiers: Prologue[/b] Steam page[/url] and find the Playtest section (just above the announcements). Next, look for the green [b]Request Access button ✅[/b], click it and...[b] it's done![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/a7552ee46181f9ff8eee095957fdc2924cbe2920.png[/img]

[h2]Please Note 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a [b]"work-in-progress" version of the game[/b], the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Viking Frontiers is sure to receive numerous patches, most of them [b]based on your feedback.[/b] Thank you for your understanding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/0e7320fdea959f4dbf49a151988816d2a86ee532.gif[/img]

It's also worth mentioning that the full version of the game will be much richer in content, with a multitude of new features, events and activities that the player can undertake. The Playtest showcases [b]only a fraction of what awaits us in the future,[/b] however we believe it will give you an understanding of what Viking Frontiers is all about.


[h2]What awaits you in the Prologue Playtest? ⚒️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[b]A powerful storm[/b] took its toll. The remnants of your clan have washed ashore. Supplies, tools and weapons have disappeared deep underwater... The situation looks bleak.

As the leader of the tribe, your job will be to[b] keep your people sheltered, fed, and safe[/b]. Explore an unknown island, obtain resources, craft tools, build houses and workshops, cultivate the land, and lead your clan to regain its former glory. Who knows, you might even develop a relationship with the [b]mighty pantheon of Norse gods... or challenge other Jarls.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/9d366b0ab11d77ab14698c14c63f58c64b10e0ec.gif[/img]

The main goal of the Playtest is to [b]familiarize players with the basic gameplay mechanics[/b] and gather their valuable feedback. Speaking of which, we will soon publish a dedicated [b]Playtest Feedback Form[/b]. Be sure to share your feelings and thoughts about the game, alright? 


[h2]More info coming soon! 📣[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We promise that we won't make you wait long for Playtest to launch. Be on the lookout, as we will soon provide more information about its start date. We wish you good luck in gaining access and great adventures in unexplored Nordic lands.


[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.title: Open World Survival Crafting Fest and new Demo 🤓
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
There are many terms that can describe the content of our beloved Viking Frontiers project. Open world? For sure! Survival? Check. Crafting? Yep! [b]Our game appears to be a perfect fit[/b] for the brand-new Steam event, the launch of which we are celebrating today...

Behold, Jarls! We are happy to announce, that [b]Viking Frontiers is taking part in the Steam Open World Survival Crafting Fest[/b] 🤩 And that means lots of exciting news and updates!


[h2]Join us in the Fest and try the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/]Demo[/url]![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949212/4661da076e1195440a4503473250098b34c5ba59.png[/img]


[h2]New Demo - new features and content[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The last time you had the opportunity to visit the northern lands of Viking Frontiers [b]was over 3 months ago. [/b]And a lot has changed since then! ⚒️ The demo we have prepared on the occasion of Steam Survival Fest is definitely different from the one you remember from the beginning of the year. And it's not just about a new map or additional features! 


[h3]In addition to what you experienced in the first Demo, you can expect:[/h3]

• New map and new plot line
• Settler needs system  
• Better settlers AI and behaviors
• Animals and hunting system
• Raid system allowing you to attack other clans (*early version)
• Assigning your own house
• Improvements to production system
• Numerous adjustments, fixes and improvements

As you can see, there are many new challenges ahead. But along with the tough challenges comes the chance to [b]become the most glorious Viking in history! [/b]📜 Don't let this unique event pass you by, wishlist Viking Frontiers now and try your hand as a Norse ruler in the Open World Survival Crafting Fest Demo version of the game! 


[h2]Don't forget to share your [url=https://forms.gle/CYxA6FCnh3WPdVM89]feedback[/url][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
One of the main goals of launching the new Demo is to collect your [b]honest feedback, interesting ideas and insightful suggestions[/b]. As always, you can share them via our [b][url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy]Discord server [/url][/b], Social Media channels or the 👉 [b][url=https://forms.gle/CYxA6FCnh3WPdVM89]Dedicated Feedback Form [/url][/b]. We are always happy to see your comments and opinions, so we will be very grateful for your help, everyone! 

It's time to discover the unknown. [b]Establish a new foothold[/b] in wild, dangerous lands. To lead your people to safety and honor. To collect, craft, build, trade and make fateful decisions. But remember... other Jarls will not remain indifferent to your[b] increase in power![/b] Looks like you need to send them a message ⚔️✊ 



[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]
